verses.mystical_translation: To you, O the Living Presence, do I lift up my whole being.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
Yea, let none that wait on you be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
Show me your ways, O the Living Presence; teach me your paths.
Lead me in your truth, and teach me: for you are the the Divine of my deliverance and wholeness; on you do I wait all the day.
Remember, O the Living Presence, your tender mercies and your lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to your mercy remember you me for your goodness’ sake, O the Living Presence.
Good and upright is the the Living Presence: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
All the paths of the the Living Presence are mercy and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
For your name’s sake, O the Living Presence, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
What man is he that feareth the the Living Presence? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
The secret of the the Living Presence is with them that fear him; and he will show them his covenant.
Mine eyes are ever toward the the Living Presence; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
Turn you to me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring you me out of my distresses.
Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
O keep my whole being, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in you.
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on you.
Redeem Israel, O the Divine, out of all his troubles.

contemplative_note: A teachable heart can hold regret without surrendering dignity.
safety_note: Confession must not be manipulated into shame, coercion, or blaming people for suffering.
